name: What preparation is needed before a shower tile installation begins?

mainEntity.name: What preparation is needed before a shower tile installation begins?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before your tile contractor arrives, remove all personal toiletries, shower curtains, and hanging organizers from the bathroom. Ensure clear access between the entryway and the bathroom for hauling heavy materials, cement backer boards, and tile saws. Finalize your tile choices, grout color, pattern layout, and any niche or fixture placements in advance. If plumbing fixtures or mixing valves are being updated during the renovation, having the hardware on-site prevents installation delays while the wall cavities remain open.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear out personal items, finalize tile and grout selections, provide clear hallway access, and have any new plumbing hardware ready on-site.
